register.labelZh: HACK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: HACK 片語動詞可以分辨反覆砍某物、胡亂剪壞某物、砍掉其中一部分,以及把整件物件砍成小塊等不同動作。；當有人未經准許進入電腦系統或網上帳戶時,英語經常使用 HACK INTO。；HACK SOMEBODY OFF 和 BE HACKED OFF 是日常英式英語中表達惱怒的自然說法。；HACK AT、HACK ABOUT、HACK OFF 和 HACK UP 都與切割有關,但所描述的動作和最終結果並不相同。
register.summaryEn: HACK expressions can distinguish between repeatedly cutting at something, damaging it with careless cuts, removing one part and cutting the whole thing into pieces. HACK INTO is frequently used when somebody enters a computer system or online account without permission. HACK SOMEBODY OFF and BE HACKED OFF are natural informal ways to talk about being annoyed. HACK AT, HACK ABOUT, HACK OFF and HACK UP all involve cutting, but the action and final result are different.
